tandc.title: Terms & Conditions
tandc.subtitle: Please read and accept to continue
tandc.body:
By using Crisis Reporter, you agree to our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

Crisis Reporter collects location data, photos, and description information to support UNDP crisis response operations. Your data is stored securely and shared only with authorised UNDP staff.

You may submit reports anonymously or with a verified profile. Your Reporter ID is assigned to your device and persists across sessions.

By tapping I Agree, you confirm that you have read and understood these terms and consent to the collection and use of your data as described.

You may withdraw at any time by uninstalling the app.
tandc.declineAlertMessage: You are unable to access Crisis Reporter without accepting the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. If you change your mind, please reopen the app and try again.

welcomeCard.body: Crisis Reporter helps you document damage to buildings and infrastructure after a disaster. You can report earthquakes, floods, conflicts, and other crises. Your reports help UNDP get help to the right places faster.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: Structural damage from ground shaking and tremors.

flood.name: Flood
flood.description: Water damage from overflow, heavy rain, or storm surge.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.description: Coastal damage from large ocean waves following seismic events.

hurricane.name: Hurricane or Cyclone
hurricane.description: Wind and rain damage from tropical storms.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.description: Fire damage to buildings and infrastructure.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Blast damage from industrial or other explosive events.

chemical.name: Chemical Incident
chemical.description: Damage or hazard from chemical spill or release.

conflict.name: Conflict
conflict.description: Damage from armed conflict or military activity.

civilUnrest.name: Civil Unrest
civilUnrest.description: Damage from protests, riots, or civil disturbance.

guidelines.title: Photo guidelines
guidelines.g1: Make sure the damage is clearly visible in the photo
guidelines.g2: Avoid photos that are too dark or blurry
guidelines.g3: Take the photo from a safe distance — do not put yourself at risk
guidelines.g4: Include the full structure in the frame where possible
